parameters.name: name
parameters.explanation: 设备的名称，用于标识网络中的设备。

set protocols mpls label-ce mpls.explanation: 配置MPLS协议的标签交换边缘（CE）功能。

parameters.name: label-ce
parameters.explanation: 指定MPLS标签交换边缘的类型。

set protocols mpls enable-on-if ge-2/0/0.explanation: 在指定接口上启用MPLS协议。

set protocols ospf area 0.0.0.0 interfac.command: set protocols ospf area 0.0.0.0 interface lo0.0
set protocols ospf area 0.0.0.0 interfac.explanation: 在指定OSPF区域中配置接口。

set protocols ospf area 0.0.0.0 interfac.command: set protocols ospf area 0.0.0.0 interface ge-2/0/0-unit-0
set protocols ospf area 0.0.0.0 interfac.explanation: 在指定OSPF区域中配置接口。

set interfaces ge-1/0/0 unit 0 family en.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family encapsulation dot1q vlan-id [parameter3]
set interfaces ge-1/0/0 unit 0 family en.command: set interfaces ge-1/0/0 unit 0 family encapsulation dot1q vlan-id 2

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: 接口单元号，用于区分同一接口下的多个逻辑配置。

set interfaces ge-1/0/0.1 unit 0 family.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family l2vlan forwarding-vlan-id [parameter3] neighbor [parameter4] label [parameter5]
set interfaces ge-1/0/0.1 unit 0 family.command: set interfaces ge-1/0/0.1 unit 0 family l2vlan forwarding-vlan-id 2 neighbor 192.168.2.2 label 100
set interfaces ge-1/0/0.1 unit 0 family.explanation: 配置L2VPN接口的转发VLAN ID、邻居地址和标签。

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: 接口单元号，用于区分同一接口下的多个逻辑配置。

parameters.name: forwarding-vlan-id
parameters.explanation: 转发VLAN ID，用于指定数据包的转发VLAN。

parameters.name: label
parameters.explanation: MPLS标签，用于标识数据包的转发路径。

set interfaces ge-2/0/0 unit 0 family in.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family inet address [parameter3]/[parameter4]
set interfaces ge-2/0/0 unit 0 family in.command: set interfaces ge-2/0/0 unit 0 family inet address 10.2.2.2/24
set interfaces ge-2/0/0 unit 0 family in.explanation: 配置接口的IPv4地址及子网掩码。

set interfaces lo0 unit 0 family inet ad.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family inet address [parameter3]/[parameter4]

set interfaces lo0 unit 0 family inet ad.explanation: 配置环回接口的IPv4地址及子网掩码。
